title: 第二十五章 不卖第二十六章 威逼利诱
slug: 柳无邪和徐凌雪的小说
content_zh:
整整两天时间，不眠不休的修炼，境界稳固在后天八重巅峰。
还剩下最后一天时间，全力炼制天灵丹。
地面上的药材不断减少，一枚枚天灵丹出炉，第五天如约而至。
徐家大门刚打开，雷涛已经站在大门外，吓得徐家下人一个哆嗦，以为前来找事，最近徐家很不太平。
说明来意，徐义林亲自出来迎接，上次斗兽场没有丹宝阁，今天的徐家，又是一番光景。
雷涛来到柳无邪院落的时候，睁大着眼睛，不敢相信，他眼前站着的野人，是三天前大杀四方的柳公子。
头发跟鸡窝一样，身上脏兮兮的，三天三夜，不眠不休，投入修炼跟炼丹之中。
“我要的药材到了吗？”
柳无邪也没邀请他进屋。
两人站在院子里面，地面上一片狼藉，连个落脚的地方都没有。
“快了，已经到城门处。”
雷涛如实回答。
五天前，从帝都城调来九阳果、赤灵草两种药材，今天就到沧澜城。
“这是五百枚天灵丹，下一批十天后过来取。”
柳无邪并未拿出炼制之法，拿出几十个瓷瓶，里面装满着丹药，这些卖出去，可以换取一大笔金钱，购买灵石修炼。
达到先天境，更需要大量的灵石，单凭灵气速度太慢，尤其他的丹田，异于常人，荒芜、古老，丹田演绎出来沧海桑田，承载的真气是常人十几倍，需要的资源同样恐怖。
雷涛也没拆穿，柳无邪在防着他们丹宝阁，拿到炼制之法，翻脸不认人，不给他九阳果跟赤阳草，防人之心不可无。
打开一瓶，倒出一粒天灵丹，放入口中，一股精纯的灵元，在他胸腔炸开，雷涛眼神微变。
“好丹药。”
灵元还未彻底炼化，储存在身体之中，他没有太荒之躯，炼化的速度远不及柳无邪。

简单说了几句，雷涛飞速离开，就在昨天，丹宝阁已经通知整个沧澜城，今天会有新丹药面世，价格不高，低于养心丹，高于培元丹，效果却远远高出这两种丹药。
打来一盆清水，身体好好梳洗一遍，院子里面的垃圾，清理干净，已经是上午时分，这才转身离开徐家。
一个时辰后，好不容易挤进丹宝阁，早上拿回来的五百枚丹药，一上午时间，销售一空。
远远超出柳无邪的预料，天灵丹面世，席卷整个沧澜城，整整一天时间，都在议论天灵丹。
“我们还没买到，丹宝阁赶紧拿库存出来。”
没有买到的武者拍着柜台，迟迟不肯离去，不买到天灵丹决不罢休的架势。
“真的不好意思，天灵丹已经销售一空，下一批要等到十天之后。”
小厮做出无奈状，连他们都不知道天灵丹从何而来，一夜之间就冒出来了。
“鬼才相信你们，丹宝阁难道有生意都不做吗。”
这倒是实话，丹宝阁也很头疼，天灵丹的面世，导致培元丹跟养心丹滞销，一颗没卖出去，这不是好现象，意味着失去柳无邪，丹宝阁没有任何经济收入。
柳无邪没有理会他们，直径走到柜台处。
“我来拿九阳果跟赤灵草。”
按照时间计算，这时候已经到了丹宝阁，拿到两株药材，即可炼制续脉丹。
“柳公子稍等，我这就去通知雷执事。”
这两味药材刚运来不久，由雷执事亲自签收，他们都没权负责，经历上次大闹丹宝阁之后，这些小厮见到柳无邪表面很客气，眼神中还有一丝恨意。
content_en:
For two whole days, he practiced non-stop, and his state was stabilized at the acquired eighth level peak.
There is only one day left to refine the Heavenly Spirit Pill.
The medicinal materials on the ground continued to decrease, and one heavenly elixir was released, and the fifth day arrived as promised.
As soon as the Xu family's door opened, Lei Tao was already standing outside the door. The servants of the Xu family trembled in fright, thinking that they were here to cause trouble. The Xu family has been very uneasy recently.
After explaining his purpose, Xu Yilin came out to greet him personally. There was no Danbao Pavilion in the Colosseum last time. Today, the Xu family is in a different situation again.
When Lei Tao came to Liu Wuxie's courtyard, he opened his eyes wide and couldn't believe that the savage standing in front of him was Young Master Liu who had massacred everyone three days ago.
My hair was like a chicken coop and my body was dirty. For three days and three nights, I stayed awake and devoted myself to cultivation and alchemy.
"Has the medicine I asked for arrived?"
Liu Wuxie didn't invite him into the house either.
The two of them stood in the yard. The ground was in a mess and there was no place to stay.
"Come on, we're already at the city gate."
Lei Tao answered truthfully.
Five days ago, two medicinal materials, Jiuyang Fruit and Red Spirit Grass, were transferred from the Imperial City and arrived in Canglan City today.
"These are five hundred Heavenly Spirit Pills. The next batch will be picked up in ten days."
Liu Wuxie did not come up with the refining method, but took out dozens of porcelain bottles filled with elixirs. These could be sold in exchange for a large amount of money to buy spiritual stones for cultivation.
Reaching the Xiantian realm requires a large amount of spiritual stones. Relying on spiritual energy alone is too slow. Especially his Dantian, which is different from ordinary people. It is desolate and ancient. The Dantian embodies the vicissitudes of life and carries more than ten times the energy of ordinary people. The resources required are equally terrifying.
Lei Tao didn't reveal it either. Liu Wuxie was guarding their Danbao Pavilion. After getting the refining method, he turned against him and refused to recognize him. He refused to give him the Nine Yang Fruit and Red Sun Grass. He was extremely defensive.
He opened a bottle, poured out a Heavenly Spirit Pill, and put it into his mouth. A stream of pure spiritual energy exploded in his chest, and Lei Tao's eyes changed slightly.
"Good elixir."
The spirit essence has not yet been completely refined and is stored in the body. He does not have Taihuang's body, and the speed of refining is far slower than Liu Wuxie.
After a few simple words, Lei Tao left quickly. Just yesterday, Danbao Pavilion had informed the entire Canglan City that a new elixir would be available today. The price is not high, lower than the Yangxin Dan and higher than the Peiyuan Dan, but the effect is far higher than these two elixirs.
I fetched a basin of water, washed myself thoroughly, and cleaned up the garbage in the yard. It was already morning, and then I turned around and left Xu's house.
An hour later, I finally squeezed into the Danbao Pavilion. The five hundred pills I got back in the morning were sold out in the morning.
Far beyond Liu Wuxie's expectation, the Tianling Pill came out and swept the entire Canglan City. There was a whole day of discussion about the Tianling Pill.
"We haven't bought it yet. Danbao Pavilion should quickly bring out the inventory."
The warriors who didn't buy it slapped the counter and refused to leave, showing that they would never give up until they bought the Tianling Pill.
"I'm really sorry, the Tianling Pill has been sold out, and the next batch will have to wait until ten days."
The boy looked helpless. Even they didn't know where the Tianling Pill came from. It appeared overnight.
"Only a ghost believes you. Don't Danbao Pavilion even do business?"
This is true, Danbao Pavilion also has a headache. The emergence of Tianling Pill has caused the Peiyuan Pill and Yangxin Dan to be unsaleable, and none of them have been sold. This is not a good phenomenon, which means that without Liu Wuxie, Danbao Pavilion will not have any financial income.
Liu Wuxie ignored them and walked directly to the counter.
"I'll get the Nine Sun Fruit and Red Spirit Grass."
According to time calculation, we have arrived at Danbao Pavilion at this time, and after obtaining two medicinal materials, we can refine the Meridian Renewal Pill.
"Mr. Liu, wait a moment, I'm going to inform Deacon Lei right now."
These two medicinal materials had just arrived and were signed by Deacon Lei personally. They had no right to take responsibility. After the last trouble in Danbao Pavilion, these young men saw that Liu Wuxie was very polite on the surface, but there was still a trace of hatred in his eyes.意。
